no-restricted-globals.name: crypto
no-restricted-globals.message: Do not use, does not work in environments without SSL.

paths.name: prosemirror-tables
paths.message: Use the wrappers from shared/editor/commands/table instead, which respect the target index and place the cursor in the inserted cell.

paths.name: sonner
paths.message: Do not import a toast library within shared; surface notifications through the onNotice callback so shared code stays decoupled from the app's toast implementation.

patterns.message: Do not reference app code from shared code.
Do not reference server code from shared code.
Do not use the mime-types package in the browser.
